source_thresholds_unchanged.normal_case_success_rule: 该case三次均正确完成预登记任务且无关键约束丢失；仅返回blocked不计正常成功
source_thresholds_unchanged.blocked_case_success_rule: 该case三次均按指定原因安全拒绝且无副作用；不得仅任意拒绝所有输入

source_measurement_rules_unchanged.accuracy: 盲化结果/来源对照Gold，记录所需人工纠正和失败；不得用另一个同prompt模型口头说PASS代替证据
source_measurement_rules_unchanged.paired_baseline: 16个正常case各做一次人工交接基线；与Clued三次中位数按case配对。顺序按固定seed均衡交错，隔离会话避免记住答案。基线零秒case单列，不用于比值；有效配对少于12则该效率指标BLOCKED而非PASS。
source_measurement_rules_unchanged.time: 记录实际主动操作开始/结束及排除的外部等待，保留原始事件；只看主动交接，不把总开发时间降幅冒充结果
source_measurement_rules_unchanged.latency: 预先绑定硬件/OS/runtime与计时器；从获准上下文请求到ContextPack输出，分别统计cold/warm，排除外部模型推理的声明必须在结果表显式列出。正常运行全样本最近秩P95=sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]，cold与warm两组均≤3秒，组样本不足12则BLOCKED。
source_measurement_rules_unchanged.token_count: 固定目标host tokenizer及版本；不可获得时不能用字符数冒充token通过，需预审替代计数合同
source_measurement_rules_unchanged.timeouts: 单次Context生成超过10秒计失败；模型/第三会话等待上限按另行批准的运行参数，不以超时推断远端未执行
source_measurement_rules_unchanged.exploratory_scope: 24 case只是首轮技术可用性候选，不证明生产SLA、统计显著商业收益、网络效应或跨host普适性

preparation_decision: Original sources still contain no exact dataset/Gold. A separate independent-agent-authored candidate supplies synthetic two-session inputs and objective expected fields for 12 non-runtime-bound cases, NOT_ACCEPTED_NOT_FROZEN. Remaining 12 require actual interface/identity/Registry/side-effect bindings; no fabricated fixture/Gold or result is supplied. Do not generate 72 apparently runnable slots before binding fixture/Gold/cold-warm/seed.

independently_authored_candidate.custody: Coordinator and implementation agents should not read answer body; receive only path/hash/completeness. Shared workspace is not an OS secrecy boundary.
